# awscc_mediaconvert_preset (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::MediaConvert::Preset



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `settings_json` (String) Specify, in JSON format, the transcoding job settings for this output preset. This specification must conform to the AWS Elemental MediaConvert job validation. For information about forming this specification, see the Remarks section later in this topic.

### Optional

- `category` (String) The new category for the preset, if you are changing it.
- `description` (String) The new description for the preset, if you are changing it.
- `name` (String) The name of the preset that you are modifying.
- `tags` (String)

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the output preset, such as arn:aws:mediaconvert:us-west-2:123456789012
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_mediaconvert_preset.example
  identity = {
    name = "name"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the preset that you are modifying

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_mediaconvert_preset.example
  id = "name"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_mediaconvert_preset.example "name"
```
